chunks: And it is narrated from al-‘Alim عليه السلام that he said:
Work for your worldly life as if you will live forever, and work for your Hereafter as if you will die tomorrow.

key_terms.لِآخِرَتِكَ: For your Hereafter and eternal destiny.
key_terms.لِدُنْيَاكَ: For your worldly life and material affairs.

ai.seo_question: How should a believer balance worldly work and preparation for the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a balanced approach between worldly livelihood and preparation for the Hereafter. It encourages diligence and long-term effort in worldly affairs while urging urgency, seriousness, and readiness for death in relation to one's Hereafter.
